prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1259; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports the other vehicle drifted into their lane on the highway and contacted the driver side rear quarter panel. Both drivers stopped at the roadside. Insured reports a neck and back strain and was evaluated at a local clinic. Claimant is not represented by counsel. Photos requested from both parties.

Entry 2: Spoke with the claimant by phone. Claimant confirms they were changing lanes when the other vehicle came alongside and made contact. Claimant describes stiffness in the neck and lower back and some pain when turning the head. Claimant has not yet seen a physician for follow-up. Explained the medical authorization form and the process for submitting treatment records. Claimant has no attorney at this time.

Entry 3: Reviewed photos from the claimant's phone. Visible scuffing and a dented rear door panel on the claimant's vehicle. Damage on the other vehicle appears to be a scraped front fender on the passenger side. Consistent with the reported sideswipe. Requested the police report number from the claimant and confirmed it has been filed.

Entry 4: Received the clinic's initial visit notes. Diagnosis listed as cervical and lumbar strain with muscle spasm. Treatment plan includes physical therapy twice weekly for four weeks and over-the-counter pain relief. Claimant reports sleep disruption from discomfort. Set a reminder to request therapy progress notes at the end of the treatment period.

Entry 5: Contacted the other driver's carrier to confirm liability position. Carrier acknowledges its insured was changing lanes and has accepted preliminary responsibility pending review of the statement. Claimant remains unrepresented and has been advised of the next steps, including the rental vehicle coverage available under the policy. File remains open for injury evaluation.
